name: lightning breath
desc:
The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} exhales lightning in a 90-foot line that is 5 ft. wide. Each creature in that line must make a  DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
